title: Free representable homotopy classes compute section homology
statement: Let C be a category with object universe u and morphism universe v, J a Grothendieck topology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and assume sheafification with coefficients in abelian groups of universe v [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let K be any nonnegative cochain complex in the abelian category of abelian sheaves [def-sp-abelian], and let q be a natural number. Let A(U) be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on the representable U. Extend K by zero to an integer-indexed complex. Define P(U) to be the abelian group of maps in the homotopy category from A(U)[0] to K[q]; restrictions are precomposition with A on morphisms of C. Define L to be the degree-q homology presheaf of K after applying sheafToPresheaf termwise. For every universe w, the lift of P from max(u,v) to max(u,v,w) is naturally isomorphic to the lift of L from v to max(u,v,w). No injectivity, resolution, or HasExt assumption is made.

source.place: Section 01FT and Tag 03F3, Hom-sections part of the injective-resolution computation; combined with derived.tex Tag 06XR (1), the homotopy-class description. Read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03F3 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06XR in second reading. Mathlib CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv and leftHomologyData supply the homotopy-classes/Hom-complex identification; the Hom-sections argument does not use injectivity.

proof.text: The sheafification adjunction, the whiskered free abelian adjunction and Yoneda give an additive sections equivalence. Their left and right naturality assemble freeSectionsFunctorIso, a natural isomorphism between restricted additive Hom presheaves and the underlying sheaf presheaf followed by the universe lift. Map this isomorphism termwise to the integer extension of K and apply degree-q homology.

Apply singleHomotopyPresheaf_homology to the actual free-representable sheaf functor and the integer extension of K. This gives a natural isomorphism from the homotopy presheaf to homology of the degreewise Hom presheaf complex. Compose with the homology of freeSectionsFunctorIso.

Apply mapExtendHomology_nonempty_iso to sheafToPresheaf followed by presheaf universe lift. This replaces the integer extension homology by the natural-indexed homology. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for the presheaf universe lift identifies it with the lift of the original presheaf homology. Whisker by the final universe lift and use the explicit componentwise additive equivalence unlift-unlift-lift to collapse the two lifts.

proof_origin.place: Adjunction.whiskerRight, homEquiv_naturality_left/right; Mathlib HomComplexCohomology, HomComplexSingle, ExtendHomology and ShortComplex/PreservesHomology, as recorded in the two new proved tool nodes.

lean.statement:
theorem freeRepresentableHomotopyPresheaf_homology
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) ℕ) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      (freeRepresentableHomotopyPresheaf J K q ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{w, max u v} ≅
        (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          K).homology q ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{max u w, v})
